title: Pangolin (Phylogenetic Assignment of Named Global Outbreak Lineages)
description: Software and web app for assigning SARS-CoV-2 genomes to Pango lineages; documentation hub with quick reference, installation, usage, output, and tutorial materials. Available as a GPLv3 command-line tool and a web application developed by the Centre for Genomic Pathogen Surveillance. ([cov-lineages.org](https://cov-lineages.org/resources/pangolin.html))
keyFeatures: Assigns most-likely Pango lineage to SARS-CoV-2 query sequences.
Available as command-line tool (GPL-3.0) and web application.
Pipeline supports pangoLEARN and UShER inference modes.
Uses minimap2 and gofasta for alignment; integrates scorpio checks against constellations for VOC/VOI.
Web app workflow includes visualization link-outs to Microreact.
practicalUse: Use Pangolin to classify SARS-CoV-2 sequences by Pango lineage for genomic surveillance, variant monitoring, and reporting; deploy via CLI in pipelines or via the web app when command-line access is limited.
formatDetails: Web documentation page linking to quick reference, pipeline description, installation, updating, usage, output, and a web app tutorial; CLI licensed GPL-3.0; web app hosted separately.
